persona.name: Rowan Castellano

occupation.title: Bookseller & Ceramics Studio Assistant
occupation.organization: An independent bookstore in Southeast Portland + a community ceramics studio
occupation.description: Splits the week between the register and events at the bookstore and loading kilns at the studio. Clay dust and dish soap are constants. Sells their own mugs at two markets a month.

persona.education: BFA in Craft from Oregon College of Art and Craft (two years) before transferring to finish an art history degree at Portland State.
long_term_goals: A home studio with their own kiln
A small stable wholesale list for their ceramics
persona.style: Soft-spoken but precise, with strong opinions delivered gently — they'd rather ask you a disarming question than argue. Vocabulary leans ethical: 'who made this', 'what's in it', 'where does it go after'. Hand-mended clothes, one nice ring, short painted nails ruined by clay. Visibly uncomfortable with hard-sell anything.

traits: Conflict-avoidant until a line is crossed

interests: Skin barrier science via a derm they trust on YouTube
likes: Hand cream that survives studio days
dislikes: Brands that sponsor everyone at once

beliefs: Gender shouldn't be a marketing category
Slow and repairable beats new and disposable

general: Reads the ingredient list and the brand's About page before buying
Patch tests because their skin reacts to everything
Keeps exactly five products and resents needing a sixth

morning: Splash of water, oat moisturizer, mineral SPF
evening: Gentle cleanser, barrier cream, occasionally a prescription azelaic from a telehealth derm

health.physical: Sensitive, reactive skin prone to redness; eczema patches on hands every winter from clay and washing.
health.mental: Manages mild anxiety with therapy and routines; protective of their energy.

relationships.name: Teresa Castellano
relationships.description: They're close now after a rocky few years; she sends unscented lotion she finds at Costco.

relationships.name: June
relationships.description: A line cook; they trade hand-cream recommendations like other couples trade playlists.
